No bracketing-number declaration was located, and metric balls do not enforce order brackets.

library_audit.gap: The bracketing-number construction still needs a minimum-cardinality bracket cover with explicitly chosen endpoint, order and width conventions absent from the source definition.

library_audit.gap: Metric entropy is composable after fixing the source-unspecified covering-center and radius conventions and handling any infinite covering number explicitly.

searches.result: Expected nonnegative loss and nested order infima/suprema express the criterion after defining the full estimator domain and truth-indexed sample laws.
